rows.notes: Guangxi, Baise High-tech Zone. 14 Mar 2025 city-wide Q1 major-projects groundbreaking ceremony incl. this project (S1). Phases (S2, 2025-07-18): phase 1 3 GWh LFP ESS cells + 3 GWh ESS integration systems (~RMB 1.5bn); phase 2 3 GWh ESS cells + 3 GWh integration systems (~RMB 1.3bn). Project company shareholders per the S2 page (paraphrase, not quoted): Baise Juyouneng 70%, Kunyu Power 25%, Guangxi Baise Energy Investment Development Group 5%; parent_company/jv_partners left null for lack of a quote. Not in DB (grep of operator/city/county). No coordinates (GEO not located).

fields.plant_name: Ampace Xiamen battery base (Phase I + Phase II, CATL-ATL JV)

rows.notes: Xiamen (Tongxiang High-tech City per CATL annual-report lead in operator_sites/T002.csv; the fetched pages do not name the district). Phase I: signed Sep 2021, construction Dec 2021, full production end-2023 (S10; phase I GWh not stated on the page). Phase II (780 mu): planned 18 GWh, RMB 10 bn (S9); Phase II stage 1 approved Nov 2024 (nine new cell lines + thirty module lines per EnergyTrend); stage 2 ~9 GWh, RMB 5.7 bn broke ground ~Dec 2025 (S9 page, no exact date). Production-area buildings passed completion acceptance 7 Nov 2025 (S10). Nameplate 32 GWh = site total 'projected annual production capacity' (S11, Wikipedia, secondary; 32 minus 18 implies ~14 GWh for phase I but that split is NOT stated by any fetched source). Because the 32 GWh rests on Wikipedia only (plus consistent phase II 18 GWh from trade press) confidence is 0.55 -> ESCALATE: large plant (>=10 GWh) below 0.6 gate G4; a company or government source for the 32 GWh / phase I figure is needed. ref_year: fallback, searched (2025 = publication year; stage-2 completion year not stated). installed null (no sourced figure). Wikipedia calls the site '900-acre' while the trade press says Phase II alone is 780 mu - unit inconsistency, not used. Distinct from existing CATL Xiamen rows (CATL's own Xiamen Times New Energy) - Ampace is a separate JV company; lead should confirm the existing CATL Xiamen rows do not already count Ampace lines (T002 operator_sites lists Ampace as unmatched / no_open_source). No coordinates.
